text_block_list.text:
On this day, Symboli Rudolf looked 
terribly sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... A bit. I got a little too absorbed 
in my hobby last night.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Puns" truly are profound. When the rhymes 
get too sophisticated, they actually stop 
being funny.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's what they call “hoist with one's own 
petard.” Just like in a race, a momentary 
flash of inspiration is what's truly 
essential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, even after digging deep, nothing 
good came to mind, so I just ended up 
sleep-deprived. *yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Puns make you sleepy, pun-derfully so? 
...Just kidding.

With her brain out of commission, Symboli 
Rudolf's pun quality suffered a massive 
drop as well.
